descbody.para: The MMEL revision adds, updates, or deletes information. The Operator determines the revision cycle. For urgent update, Airbus issues an immediate revision regardless of the revision cycle.
An issue date identifies each MMEL revision.

item.para: In the Transmittal Letter for the PDF format, and
In the LIBRARY panel of the OPS LIBRARY Browser for the electronic consultation.

note.para: The issue date is different from the EASA approval date. The EASA approval date appears in the MMEL Approval Reference of the MMEL Preamble. The applicability date of this MMEL is based on the issue date and not on the EASA approval date ().

unlist.para: Each MMEL revision contains the following information that is useful to update the MMEL and to identify the changes that the revision has inserted:

item.para: The Transmittal Letter (in PDF format only),
The List of Effective Sections/Subsections (LESS) (in PDF format only),
The Filling Instructions (in PDF format only),
The List of Effective Documentary Units (LEDU),
The Summary of Highlights (SOH).
An Aircraft Allocation Table (AAT),
A List of Modifications (LOM).

descbody.para: When there is a change within a DU, the MMEL revision updates the whole subsection that contains the DU.
The Transmittal Letter is a way of communication between Airbus and the Operators. The Transmittal Letter also specifies the issue date of the MMEL revision.
The Transmittal Letter only exists in the PDF format.

unlist.para: In the PDF format, the header of the page contains the subsection title whereas the footer contains:

item.para: The subsection identification,
The subsection issue date. The subsection issue date corresponds to the issue date of the latest MMEL revision that has revised the subsection.
The page number within this subsection and the total number of pages within this subsection.
The Table of Contents (TOC) indexing.

descbody.para: This TOC indexing uses the TOC indexes. Each TOC entry has an alphabetical index that identifies this TOC entry within its subsection. The manual user can easily find a TOC entry content within the manual thanks to this alphabetical index and the subsection identification. Both are indicated in the TOC and both cross-refer to the PDF page footer.

unlist.para: In the PDF page footer, the TOC indexing is of the following type:

equ-r.para: The PDF page contains the whole "B" TOC entry content.
The PDF page contains the whole "B", "C" and "D" TOC entries contents.
The "B" TOC entry content starts on this PDF page and continues on the following PDF page.
The "B" TOC entry content starts on a previous PDF page and finishes on this PDF page.
The "B" TOC entry content starts on a previous PDF page and continues on the following PDF page.
The PDF page contains the whole "B" and "C" TOC entries contents but the "D" TOC entry content starts on this PDF page and continues on the following PDF page.
The PDF page contains the whole "C" and "D" TOC entries contents but the "B" TOC entry content starts on a previous PDF page and finishes on this PDF page.

The PDF page contains the whole "C" TOC entry content but the "B" TOC entry content starts on a previous PDF page and finishes on this PDF page and the "D" TOC entry content starts on this PDF page and continues on the following PDF page.

item.para: The indexes follow the alphabetical order: A, B, C, ..., Z, AA, AB, AC, ..., AZ, BA, BB,BC, ...
For each subsection, the index starts again from A.

descbody.para: The manual is organized by sections and subsections (also called PSL). The subsections contain the DUs.
The LESS lists all the subsections that constitute this MMEL. The LESS only exists in the PDF format.
When there is a change within a DU, the MMEL revision updates the whole subsection that contains the DU. This subsection gets a new date that corresponds to the issue date of the MMEL revision.

note.para: Each subsection has its own date that corresponds to the issue date of the latest MMEL revision that has revised the subsection. Therefore subsections of a same manual might have different dates.

unlist.para: For each subsection, the LESS indicates:

item.para: The subsection identification (also referred to as localization),
The subsection title,
The subsection issue date. The subsection issue date corresponds the issue date of the latest MMEL revision that has revised the subsection.

unlist.para: The "M" field that may indicate the following Evolution Code:

item.para: The “E” letter indicates only an aircraft validity change of one or several DUs of this subsection compared to the previous MMEL revision. No DU content of this subsection has changed compared to the previous MMEL revision.
The “M” letter indicates a subsection that has moved compared to the previous MMEL revision.
The “N” letter indicates a new subsection added by this MMEL revision.
The “R” letter indicates a revised subsection. The content of one or several DUs of this subsection is updated by this MMEL revision.

descbody.para: Each PDF page footer indicates the subsection identification and the subsection issue date for cross-reference with the LESS. Therefore the manual holder can use the LESS to ensure that the MMEL is up-to-date and that no page is missing.

unlist.para: The Filling Instructions enable the manual holder:

item.para: To update the paper MMEL when a new MMEL revision is available, and
To quickly identify the subsections that the new MMEL revision has revised.

descbody.para: The Filling Instructions notify the manual holder to remove a subsection, to add a new subsection or to update an existing subsection.

unlist.para: For each revised subsection, the Filling Instructions also indicate:

item.para: The subsection identification (also referred to as localization),
The subsection title,
The new issue date of the subsection.

descbody.para: After incorporating the new revision with the Filling Instructions, the manual organization must correspond to the LESS.
The Filling Instructions only exist in the PDF format.

Each PDF page footer indicates the subsection identification and the subsection issue date for cross-reference with the Filling Instructions. Therefore the manual holder can use the Filling Instructions to update the paper MMEL and to identify the latest revised subsections.

In the PDF format, a vertical bar in the margin of the DU identifies the modified part. Each vertical bar has a numerical index that refers to the associated reason of the change in the Summary of Highlights (SOH).
The SOH lists all the changes and associated reasons of the change (if necessary) that the revision has inserted.

In electronic consultation, the vertical bar is available by selecting the “REV MARKS” option in the INFO drop down list. The user can display the associated reason of the change by clicking on the bar.

unlist.para: The AAT indicates the list of aircraft that are taken into account in this MMEL. For each aircraft, the AAT indicates the following information:

item.para: The MSN number,
The Fleet Serial Number (FSN) of the aircraft as known by Airbus,
The registration number of the aircraft as known by Airbus,
The aircraft model.

unlist.para: The “M” field may indicate the following Evolution Code:

item.para: The “N” letter indicates a new aircraft added by this MMEL revision,
The “R” letter indicates a change of the FSN or registration number or aircraft model.

descbody.para: The LOM lists the criteria (Modification Proposals (MP) and Service Bulletins (SB)) which the installation on the aircraft affects the MMEL.

item.para: The title of the criteria,
The date of incorporation of the criteria in the MMEL,
The list of aircraft that have the criteria,

unlist.para: The “M” field that may indicate the following Evolution Code:

item.para: The “E” letter indicates an aircraft validity change of the criteria. The list of aircraft to which the criteria applies has changed compared to the previous MMEL revision, by addition or deletion of one or several aircraft.
The “N” letter indicates new criteria added by this MMEL revision,
The “R” letter indicates a change in the criteria title or associated SB.
